nodes.label: Goal Progress Calculation
nodes.rationale: Progress = saved / target, clamped to 100%. Goals are independent of transactions; saved amount is manually maintained, not derived from tagged transactions.

nodes.label: Issue 01: Map One Reimbursement Income to One Expense
nodes.rationale: Smallest usable income-driven reimbursement mapping. Introduces allocation model in narrowest form. Uses many-to-many allocation table. Legacy reimbursement_tx_id and claimed_date fields preserved for now.
nodes.norm_label: issue 01: map one reimbursement income to one expense

nodes.label: Issue 02: Migrate Existing Legacy Reimbursement Links
nodes.rationale: Moves expense-driven reimbursement links (reimbursement_tx_id) into new allocation model. Migration must be idempotent. claimed_date semantics not carried forward. Legacy fields remain.
nodes.norm_label: issue 02: migrate existing legacy reimbursement links

nodes.label: Issue 03: Map One Reimbursement Income to Multiple Expenses
nodes.rationale: Allocation is automatic and deterministic: oldest-first up to each expense's remaining expected reimbursement. Excess reimbursement income remains unallocated.
nodes.norm_label: issue 03: map one reimbursement income to multiple expenses

nodes.label: Issue 04: Support Partial and Top-Up Reimbursements
nodes.rationale: One reimbursable expense can receive allocations from multiple reimbursement income transactions. Stored allocation amounts unchanged when reimbursement rates are corrected. Status derived from total allocated vs expected.
nodes.norm_label: issue 04: support partial and top-up reimbursements

nodes.label: Issue 05: Preserve Zero-Allocation Selections
nodes.rationale: Zero-allocation rows stored for auditability (row presence = selection state, allocation amount = financial state). Status derivation sums amounts, not counts rows.

nodes.label: Issue 06: Edit a Saved Mapping
nodes.rationale: Edited reimbursement income is the unit of replacement. Only rows owned by that income are updated. Cross-year mappings allowed when expense date is on or before income date.

nodes.label: Issue 07: Manually Settle an Expense
nodes.rationale: Manual settlement overrides visible expense status without altering allocations. One-click, no notes. Independent from rate recalculation so rate changes do not erase the override.

nodes.label: Issue 08: Filter Reimbursement Work in Transactions
nodes.rationale: Reuses shared status derivation module. Does not change dashboard income totals; reimbursement income remains normal income.
nodes.norm_label: issue 08: filter reimbursement work in transactions

nodes.label: Issue 09: Repurpose Reimbursements Page as Review Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Dashboard review-focused; no manual allocation editing. Removes claimed-date and due-date semantics.
nodes.norm_label: issue 09: repurpose reimbursements page as review dashboard

nodes.label: Issue 10: Clear Mappings When Transactions Stop Being Eligible
nodes.rationale: Prefer database-level cascade where schema matches. Confirmation only for user-initiated eligibility changes, not low-level helpers. Does not remove deprecated legacy columns.
nodes.norm_label: issue 10: clear mappings when transactions stop being eligible
